extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: 1990s regular-cab pickup truck, approx. 5.3 x 2.0 x 1.9 m (L x W x H), wheel diameter 0.74 m
extras.notes: generic, brand-free 1990s pickup with rounded cab, open cargo bed with dark bed liner and rail caps, body-colour front bumper, chrome rear step bumper, grey side cladding and arch flares, clear-glass headlights; front faces -Y; 4 wheels are separate objects with origin on the hub (rotate around local X to roll); hollow cab with transparent windows, bench seat and steering wheel; blank number plates, no brand, no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
